source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed building accessibility checks

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Carefully read the [minimum standards](https://statebuildings.wa.gov/accessibility).

## Frequently asked questions (FAQs)

* **How should the Site Accessibility report the condition of the building?**
   * The Site Accessibility should use the field in the header of the Inspection Report. This same field is separate from the fields under Items Reviewed. The field in the header should be used to represent the overall conditions, e.g. the inspection identified some stairs were not equipped with handrails. The overall condition of the building(s) on the site is NOT ACCESSIBLE because of this. 
* **When should reported barriers be closed out?**
   * When the barrier has been repaired and the repairs verified. 
* **What is the best way to accurately document barriers?**
   * The best method to do so is by attaching an image to the Inspection Report under Items Reviewed. An annotation can provide context
